technical_and_design_decisions: U1 & U2: Implement and expose SDK inter-process communication / REST gateway wrappers and sample applications allowing Node.js applications to interact with Java and Python SDK runtimes and Hyperledger Fabric networks.
U3: Extend peer chaincode package/install routines to support pre-compiled binaries and Docker containers as User Chaincode (UCC) packages, bypassing source compilation on peer nodes.

U4: Enhance the Validation System Chaincode (VSCC) policy evaluation module to inspect identity MSPs and policy trees upon evaluation failure, outputting human-readable signer/organization validation breakdowns at INFO/DEBUG log levels and including detail payloads in tx failure events.
U5: Extend the release Makefile and CI pipelines to cross-compile platform-specific release binaries (Linux, macOS, Windows) for configtxgen, fabric-chaintool, fabric-ca-client, and related binaries.
U6: Implement certificate fingerprint verification within Fabric MSP/Auth Handlers, supporting channel configuration settings for pinned root/intermediate CA fingerprints.
U7: Update Sphinx/ReadTheDocs documentation (`testing.html`) with guides and cross-links to test harnesses under `fabric/test/` for fast local network bootstrap and custom chaincode testing.

U8: Create a standardized `sampleconfig/config_defaults` directory containing fully populated `core.yaml`, `orderer.yaml`, and `configtx.yaml` files documenting all default values extracted from Go source initializers.
assumptions: All development, testing, and documentation will be completed by a single experienced Go and Hyperledger Fabric developer.
Target platforms for platform-specific binaries include Linux (x86_64, s390x, arm64), macOS (x86_64), and Windows (x86_64).
Existing fabric test networks (e.g., BYFN / Bootstrap scripts) are available as references for quickstart docs.
VSCC enhancements do not break determinism across endorsing and committing peers.

activities.activity_name: U1 & U2: Node.js Integration & Polyglot SDK Interoperability Samples
activities.activity_description: Develop integration wrappers, documentation, and sample applications demonstrating Node.js application interaction with Java and Python Fabric SDK environments.

activities.activity_name: U3: Pre-built User Chaincode (UCC) Deployment Mechanism
activities.activity_description: Modify chaincode packaging, installation, and launcher logic in the peer to support pre-built chaincode images and binaries without local peer source code compilation.

activities.activity_name: U4: VSCC Validation Failure Logging & Event Notification Payload Enhancements
activities.activity_description: Refactor VSCC policy evaluator to produce granular logs detailing evaluated policies, satisfied signers, missing org signatures, and propagate error details to tx validation event notifications.

activities.activity_name: U5: Platform Binary Build Automation & Packaging Scripts
activities.activity_description: Update build scripts and Makefile targets to cross-compile and tar/zip release binaries (configtxgen, fabric-chaintool, fabric-ca-client) across Linux, macOS, and Windows platforms.

activities.activity_name: U6: Certificate Fingerprint Pinning & Independent CA Verification
activities.activity_description: Implement certificate fingerprint validation in the channel MSP configuration and endorsement/auth handler pipelines, including verification against channel-configured fingerprint rules.

activities.activity_name: U7: Fabric Testing Guide & Quickstart Network Documentation
activities.activity_description: Author testing documentation in ReadTheDocs (`testing.html`) providing clear quickstart steps to spin up local test networks and linking to scripts in `fabric/test/`.
Audit Go source files for internal defaults, create complete `core.yaml`, `orderer.yaml`, and `configtx.yaml` files under `config_defaults/`, and update documentation links.

activities.activity_name: System Integration, E2E Verification & Test Suite Execution
activities.activity_description: Perform end-to-end integration testing, regression test suite execution, and verify cross-platform binary builds and documentation generation.
